decisions.statement: Each path a landing has says on its own whether its readers owe the reading.
A path saying nothing takes the answer the landing as a whole gives.
A path whose readers owe no reading carries their readings onto the body that landing left.
A path whose readers owe reading has their readings of that path dropped.
The readings of one path are dropped rather than the readings of the whole set.
A landing whose readers owe reading as a whole carries no rename handed in.
A reading is carried at the landing rather than by the command that asked.
An apply carries by the rule a landing carries by.
Whether the readers owe reading is handed in rather than read off the call.
A path the landing renamed is carried only where the command hands in the path that body came from.
A path a rename row names is neither carried nor dropped here.
Every other path a landing changed is worked out here from the base commit.

definition: what a landing carries in the read record onto the bodies that landing left, and what it drops
